title: Constant ball-mass ratio forces radial tangency x ∈ T_xM a.e. (Simon 7.3.1 proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Suppose there is a ∈ [0, ∞] with μ(B_ρ(0)) = a·ρⁿ (as a * ofReal(ρⁿ)) for every ρ > 0, where μ = R.measure and B_ρ is the open ball. Then p_x(x) = x, i.e. x ∈ approxTangentPlane n M x, for μ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (p_x being the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (ball 0 ρ) = a * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x
